title.narrative: AICHR Workshops on Intersection Between Conflict and Human Rights: Pathw

description.narrative: This is a series of six interlinked workshops on Intersection Between Conflict and Human Rights: Pathways and Approaches to Peace in ASEAN, initiated by AICHR. This project is used to support workshop 5 and 6. Workshop 5, Constructive dialogue in conflict prevention and peacebuilding. Workshop 6, Road mapping the future of ASEAN's peace, peacebuilding, conflict prevention and management initiative. The workshops will take place in Kuala Lumpur, 23-24 October 2025. Once the workshops are completed, the grantee will support the beneficiary (AICHR) in developing and finalising the draft ASEAN Pathways to Peace and the conceptual framework on peace, conflict prevention, and conflict management, using the inputs gathered from the workshops. The project supports the peace process and ensures women’s participation throughout. Women will make up at least 30% of workshop participants, and all workshops will adopt a gender sensitive approach that emphasizes the active involvement of women in peacebuilding, conflict prevention, and conflict management.
